title: How to Fix Hallucinating Agents with RAG
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation connects AI agents to verified external databases to prevent the fabrication of information.
body_markdown:
## Automate your grounding pipeline with Activepieces workflows


Activepieces eliminates manual data syncing by using pre-built connectors to feed live business data directly into your vector database for real-time model grounding.


Instead of copy-pasting documentation into a prompt, you build a visual sequence where every new support article or internal memo is automatically indexed, ensuring your agents never cite retired policies or broken links.


### Syncing live Help Scout or Zendesk articles to a vector store


Keeping an AI agent accurate requires a persistent bridge between your knowledge base and your retrieval system.


When a technician updates a troubleshooting guide in Zendesk, the customer service software, or Help Scout, the shared inbox tool, Activepieces detects the change and triggers a workflow to refresh your embeddings.


Every agent tool call and the specific data it retrieved is traced step-by-step in the Run Details UI, allowing teams like MoneyGram and FundingSocieties to audit how a grounded agent reached its conclusion.


These traces export directly to existing SIEMs, ensuring that an agent's retrieval decisions are reviewed with the same rigor as any other deterministic workflow step.


By automating this synchronization, you remove the lag between a policy change and the AI’s awareness of it, preventing the hallucination of outdated procedures.


### Creating the 'Search and Summarize' automation loop


A reliable grounding loop replaces the "generative" impulse with a strict "retrieval-first" instruction.


You configure the workflow to take a user’s query and first query the Vector Admin integration, a management tool for document chunks, to find the most relevant snippets of text.


This context is then passed to Claude Sonnet 5.5, the Anthropic model optimized for speed and intelligence, which is instructed to answer using *only* the provided data.


This structure forces the AI to act as a librarian rather than a creative writer, ensuring that every response is anchored in your specific business facts.


The visual builder allows you to map these data dependencies without writing custom API glue code.


The workflow shown here demonstrates how a document is retrieved from Google Docs, the cloud word processor, and passed through a specialized agent reader before hitting the AI.


By placing a router at the end of the chain, the system can programmatically categorize responses based on confidence scores or keywords.


Following the automated generation, the workflow must account for the reality that some answers carry more weight than others.


### Adding a human-in-the-loop approval step for high-stakes answers


For sensitive topics like pricing or legal compliance, you can insert a conditional branch that pauses the automation until a staff member reviews the output.


Activepieces allows you to route "High risk" outputs to a Slack channel, the team communication platform, or an approval email before the message is sent to the customer.


This safety valve ensures that while the AI handles the heavy lifting of drafting, a human maintains final authority over the most critical touchpoints.


Implementing this check transforms the AI from an unmonitored chatbot into a supervised assistant that respects the boundaries of your operational risk.
